none: PAS FindID 1016123: Roman coin: nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), irregular Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361 on a small round flan, Reece period 18. Obverse description: head diademed right. Reverse description: soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 10.3mm, Weight: 0.93gms, die axis: 12
